import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Draft assembled from the lead's text with new headings and in-document links; now validating anchors, links, and content fidelity.

Canonical report written and validated (anchors, URL, tables, Mermaid); now registering it as an artifact.

Registered. Now finalizing the turn.

I've published the lead's report as `202611/obsidian_vim_yank_range_flash/obsidian_vim_yank_range_flash.md` in the research repo. It is registered as `research:202611/obsidian_vim_yank_range_flash/obsidian_vim_yank_range_flash.md` (`file:explicit:5c3d0b6161998318292ce063`). The commit is declared and will land after this turn ends.

**Opening:** the file starts with the title, then a three-sentence research-query blockquote, then the infographic, then `## Bottom line`. The infographic is `obsidian_vim_yank_range_flash_infographic.png`; I confirmed it sits beside the report and is identical to the registered image.

**Restructure:**
- **New order:** bottom line, critique of the plan, the SASE prompt yank flash contract, what Obsidian provides, prior art and options, where the reports disagreed, recommended design, verification plan, risks and open questions, recommended solution, scope and sources.
- **Critique moved up:** it now comes straight after the bottom line. It has three subsections: whether it is a good idea, whether I'd take a different approach, and the requirement adjustments R1–R11.
- **Recommended solution stays last** before sources, because the request asked to end with it.
- **Headings:** numbers removed and punctuation dropped so they work as link targets. The phrase "verified, not assumed" moved out of its heading and into the section's first line. The lead's italic scope and date note now opens "Scope and sources".
- **Section references:** the lead's `§4`, `§5`, `§2.4`, `§2.5` and `§2.6` are now in-document links that name the section and item number. I also linked R8, R10 and R11, a few bottom-line points, the four design refinements, and the e2e step.

**Checks:**
- **Nothing lost:** comparing every line of the lead's report against the new file shows only headings, the added links and the new opening changed. All table rows (57 in both) and the lead's Mermaid sequence diagram and caption are unchanged, and the code blocks are untouched (6 fence lines in both).
- **Links:** every in-document link resolves under both pandoc and GitHub-style heading IDs. The only external URL, `https://github.com/replit/codemirror-vim/issues/121`, returns 200. There are no relative or repository-file links to check, and no link was unrepairable.

**Diagrams:** none were placed. The image agent's `diagrams` status was `none` (it considered 14 and rejected them all), so there is no `.diagrams.md` file and no figure anchors (`figure-<id>` count is 0).

`flash.png` and `approach.png` in `obsidian_vim_yank_highlight__grk_assets/` are left out. They belong to one of the five source reports (grk), the lead's report doesn't embed them, and the only images this step allows are the infographic and the image agent's diagrams.
